title: C-LiTE: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Cellular feature learning in Histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2611.26316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Characterising individual cells is fundamental to computational pathology, as cellular morphology informs tasks such as tumour grading, mitotic assessment and immune profiling. However, most pathology foundation models are trained on tissue patches and capture cellular features only implicitly, while existing cell-level models are either restricted to specific cell populations or rely on computationally expensive architectures with hundreds of millions of parameters. Applying ViTs directly to small cellular crops also presents an architectural challenge: upsampling increases computational cost without adding morphological information and may introduce interpolation artefacts. To address these limitations, we introduce C-LiTE, a lightweight foundation model for cellular representation learning in H&E-stained histopathology, with only 22 million parameters. translated_title: C-LiTE：一种用于组织病理学中细胞特征学习的轻量级基础模型
translated_abstract: 刻画单个细胞是计算病理学的基础，因为细胞形态学为肿瘤分级、核分裂象评估和免疫画像等任务提供了重要信息。然而，大多数病理学基础模型是在组织图像块上训练的，只能隐式地捕获细胞特征；而现有的细胞级模型要么局限于特定的细胞群体，要么依赖于具有数亿参数、计算代价高昂的架构。此外，将视觉Transformer（ViT）直接应用于小尺寸的细胞裁剪图像也存在架构上的挑战：上采样会增加计算成本却不会增加形态学信息，还可能引入插值伪影。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了C-LiTE，一个用于H&E染色组织病理学中细胞表征学习的轻量级基础模型，仅含2200万参数。C-LiTE采用了一种专为细胞输入定制的原生分辨率分词策略……
tldr: 该论文提出C-LiTE——一个仅有2200万参数的轻量级基础模型，通过原生分辨率分词策略实现H&E染色组织病理学中高效的细胞特征学习，弥补了现有模型要么隐式捕获细胞特征、要么计算开销过大且受限于特定细胞群体的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces C-LiTE, a lightweight foundation model with only 22 million parameters that leverages a native-resolution tokenisation strategy for efficient cellular feature learning in H&E-stained histopathology, addressing the limitations of existing models that either capture cellular features only implicitly or rely on computationally expensive architectures.
